mailboxes.onlyYours: You see the mailboxes you connected. Owners and admins see all of them.

empty.title: No mailboxes yet
empty.lead: Connect one below and Campbooks starts sorting its mail.

loadError.title: The mailboxes didn't load
loadError.lead: Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.

row.unverified: We couldn't verify this address: sending stays off

health.needsYou: Needs you to sign in again
health.throttled: Paused by {{provider}} for a few minutes
health.needsAnother: Needs the member who connected it to sign in again

disconnect.question: Disconnect {{address}}? Campbooks stops syncing it and gives up its access at {{provider}}.
disconnect.choice: What happens to its mail in Campbooks

delete.title: Delete its mail from Campbooks
delete.lead: Its messages, attachments, search results and drafts leave Campbooks, for everyone here.

keep.title: Keep its history, read-only
keep.lead: What is already here stays readable and searchable. Nothing new arrives, and nothing goes back to {{provider}}.

disconnect.atProvider: Either way, the mail stays in {{provider}}: nothing is deleted there.
disconnect.doneDeleted: Its mail is leaving Campbooks. It is still in {{provider}}.
disconnect.doneKept: Its history stays here, read-only. Its mail is still in {{provider}}.

wayIn.removed: It also stops being a way to sign in to Campbooks: you added it by connecting this mailbox.
wayIn.unchanged: How you sign in to Campbooks doesn’t change.

errors.gone: {{address}} wasn’t found: it may already be disconnected. Reload the page to see the list as it is.
errors.notYours: Only the person who connected {{address}} can disconnect it.

connect.title: Add a mailbox
connect.lead: Type its address and Campbooks finds how it connects: through your provider's sign-in, or with an app password.
connect.none: This Campbooks has no mail provider set up yet. Whoever runs it can add Gmail or Zoho Mail.
connect.signIn: Also use this account to sign in
connect.signInHint: Leave it ticked for your own mailbox. Untick it for a shared one, like support@: it is connected, but it doesn’t become a new way to sign in to Campbooks.

connected.title: Your mailbox is connected
connected.lead: Campbooks is bringing in its mail now.

stepUp.title: Sign in again first
stepUp.lead: Connecting a mailbox needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes.

refusal.unsupported: This Campbooks can't connect mail from that provider.
refusal.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then start again.

sign_in_again.title: You were signed out on the way
sign_in_again.lead: Sign in again, then connect the mailbox once more.

link_expired.title: That took too long
link_expired.lead: Connecting has to finish within two minutes. Start again.

cancelled_at_provider.title: Cancelled at the provider
cancelled_at_provider.lead: Nothing was connected. Start again whenever you're ready.

login_failed.title: The provider didn't let you in
login_failed.lead: Nothing was connected. Try again, or check the account at the provider.

provider_unavailable.title: The provider didn't answer
provider_unavailable.lead: Nothing was connected. Try again in a few minutes.

consent_incomplete.title: Mail access wasn't allowed
consent_incomplete.lead: Campbooks needs permission to read and send this mail. Connect again and leave mail access ticked.

account_mismatch.title: That was a different account
account_mismatch.lead: To reconnect a mailbox, sign in at the provider with that same account.

account_connected_by_another_member.title: Someone here already connected it
account_connected_by_another_member.lead: Another member of this workspace connected that mailbox. Ask them, or an owner, if you need it.

way_in_belongs_to_another_account.title: That account belongs to another Campbooks account
way_in_belongs_to_another_account.lead: Its mailbox can only be connected while signed in to that account.

mailbox_unsupported.title: This mailbox can't be connected here
mailbox_unsupported.lead: This Campbooks can't sync mail from that provider.

provider_not_configured.title: That provider isn't set up here
provider_not_configured.lead: Ask whoever runs this Campbooks to set it up.

no_offline_access.title: Ongoing access wasn't allowed
no_offline_access.lead: Campbooks needs to keep syncing while you're away. Connect again and allow it.

unknown_data_centre.title: That Zoho region isn't supported
unknown_data_centre.lead: Campbooks can't reach mail in that Zoho data centre yet.

no_mailbox.title: That account has no mailbox
no_mailbox.lead: The provider says there is no mail for it. Check that mail is turned on for the account.

unknown.title: The mailbox wasn't connected
unknown.lead: Something went wrong on the way. Try again.

admin.title: Connected accounts
admin.none: No account connected in this workspace.

add.title: Add a mailbox

address.label: Email address
address.hint: The address of the mailbox you want in Campbooks.
address.invalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

native.title: Connect {{provider}}
native.lead: {{address}} is a {{provider}} mailbox. It connects with {{provider}}'s own sign-in, so no password is typed here.
native.notHere: This Campbooks doesn't have {{provider}} set up yet. Ask whoever runs it.

fallback.title: Connect a mailbox
fallback.lead: This Campbooks connects mailboxes from these providers:

password.title: Connect {{address}}
password.appLead: {{provider}} needs an app password: a separate password just for Campbooks, which you can remove at {{provider}} at any time.
password.lead: Use an app password if your provider offers one. Otherwise, use the mailbox's own password.
password.label: Password
password.hint: Campbooks keeps it encrypted and never shows it again.

guide.label: How to get an app password at {{provider}}

yahoo.name: Yahoo
yahoo.s1: Sign in to Yahoo and open Account security.
yahoo.s2: Under External connections, choose Create app password, name it Campbooks, then Generate password.
yahoo.s3: Copy the password Yahoo shows and paste it here.

aol.name: AOL
aol.s1: Sign in to AOL and open Account security.
aol.s2: Choose Generate app password, then Get started, name it Campbooks and choose Generate password.
aol.s3: Copy the password AOL shows and paste it here.

icloud.name: iCloud
icloud.s1: Sign in at account.apple.com and open Sign-In and Security. Two-factor authentication must be on.
icloud.s2: Choose App-Specific Passwords and create one named Campbooks.
icloud.s3: Copy the password Apple shows and paste it here.

fastmail.name: Fastmail
fastmail.s1: In Fastmail, open Settings, then Privacy & Security.
fastmail.s2: Under Connected apps & API tokens, choose Manage app passwords and access, then New app password.
fastmail.s3: Name it Campbooks, keep mail access, generate it and paste it here.

gmx.name: GMX
gmx.s1: Turn on IMAP first: in GMX's mail settings, open POP3 & IMAP and allow access.
gmx.s2: Open your account's security settings and find app passwords.
gmx.s3: Create one named Campbooks. GMX shows it only once.

webde.name: WEB.DE
webde.s1: Turn on IMAP first: in WEB.DE's mail settings, open POP3/IMAP and switch it on.
webde.s2: Open your account, then Login & security, then App passwords.
webde.s3: Create one named Campbooks. WEB.DE shows it only once.

yandex.name: Yandex
yandex.s1: Turn on IMAP first: in Yandex Mail's settings, open Email clients, tick IMAP and App passwords and OAuth tokens, then save.
yandex.s2: In Yandex ID, open Security, then App passwords, and create a mail password named Campbooks.
yandex.s3: Copy it and paste it here. Yandex shows it only once.
yandex.s4: A new app password can take a few hours to start working: if the sign-in is refused, try again later.

custom.name: your provider
custom.s1: If your mail host offers app passwords, make one for Campbooks in its settings and use it here.
custom.s2: Otherwise, use the mailbox's password. If its servers aren't found, enter them under Advanced: your host's help pages list them.

advanced.invalid: Check the servers: each needs a name and a port from 1 to 65535.

errors.imap_login_refused: The mail server refused the sign-in. Check the username and password.
errors.imap_login_refused_app: The mail server refused the sign-in. {{provider}} needs an app password, not your usual password: follow the steps above.
errors.smtp_login_refused: The outgoing mail server refused the sign-in. Check the password, and that this mailbox may send mail.
errors.imap_unreachable: Campbooks couldn't reach the mail server. Check its name and port under Advanced, then try again.
errors.smtp_unreachable: Campbooks couldn't reach the outgoing mail server. Check its name and port under Advanced, then try again.
errors.imap_tls_failed: The mail server's certificate isn't valid for its name, so Campbooks didn't connect. Check the server name.
errors.smtp_tls_failed: The outgoing mail server's certificate isn't valid for its name, so Campbooks didn't connect. Check the server name.
errors.imap_not_an_imap_server: That server and port aren't an IMAP mail server. Check them under Advanced.
errors.imap_busy: The mail server is busy. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.host_refused: Campbooks can't reach that server: it's on a private network, or the port isn't a mail port (993, 143, 465 or 587).
errors.starttls_missing: That server doesn't offer an encrypted connection, so Campbooks didn't send your password. Use port 993 for IMAP and 465 for SMTP.
errors.imap_servers_required: Campbooks couldn't find this mailbox's servers. Enter them under Advanced.
errors.use_native_provider: This mailbox connects with its provider's own sign-in. Go back and use that instead.
errors.imap_password_invalid: Enter the password on one line, at most 1024 characters.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed sign-ins to this mailbox. Wait an hour, then try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.account_connected_by_another_member: Another member of this workspace already connected this mailbox.
errors.account_mismatch: That's a different mailbox from the one you're connecting again.
errors.provider_not_configured: This Campbooks can't connect mailboxes with a password.
errors.connection_needs_user: Only a signed-in member can connect a mailbox.
errors.unknown: The mailbox wasn't connected. Try again.

add.connected: {{address}} is connected. Campbooks is bringing in its mail.

check.title: Checking {{address}}
check.checkingLead: Campbooks sent a message to {{address}} through this mailbox and is looking for it in its inbox. It takes a minute or two; you can close this.
check.failed: We couldn't verify this address: sending stays off
check.failedLead: Campbooks didn't find its message in the mailbox. Reading mail works; sending from {{address}} stays off until the address is verified.
check.retryFailed: The check couldn't start. Try again in a while.
check.retryLimited: This address was checked too often today. Try again tomorrow.
